lines.intro: A fizzy bunny bounces out of the clover, thumping its foot!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the bunny?

soothe.great: Fae hums a soft lullaby. The bunny's ears droop, all sleepy!
soothe.good: Fae hums softly. The bunny's nose stops twitching.
soothe.miss: The bunny is too busy thumping to hear Fae.

play.great: Maddie and the bunny play tag in the clover. Hop, pounce, hop!
play.good: Maddie wiggles her tail. The bunny's ears perk up.
play.miss: Maddie pounces on a butterfly instead. The bunny thumps, unimpressed.

cast.great: Sue casts her ribbon bobber through the clover. The bunny bounces after it!
cast.good: Sue's bobber twirls in the breeze. The bunny's nose wiggles.
cast.miss: Sue's bobber snags on a fern. The bunny blinks.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three pinecones. The bunny's ears bob up and down with every toss!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a pinecone. The bunny sniffs it, curious.
juggle.miss: Jordan's pinecones scatter in the clover. The bunny hops right over them.

lines.snack: Fae shares a crunchy carrot stick. The bunny munches happily!
lines.burst: The bunny thumps so hard that twigs and dust go flying!

burstResult.great: Fae hops right over the flying twigs!
burstResult.good: Fae dodges most of the twigs!
burstResult.miss: Poof! Fae gets a face full of dust.

lines.soothed: The bunny lets out a happy sigh. The fizzy spell fizzles away!
lines.rest: Fae is all tuckered out. Time for a rest.
lines.run: Fae tiptoes away through the grass. The bunny keeps thumping.
